pages.text: Vanilla logic is built from torches and dust; $(italic)More Red$() sells each gate as a single labelled block, soldered at the table. The basic set:$(br)$(li)$(bold)AND$() — on only if $(italic)all$() inputs are on.$(li)$(bold)OR$() — on if $(italic)any$() input is on.$(li)$(bold)NOT$() — flips its input.
pages.title: AND · OR · NOT

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)NAND$() / $(bold)NOR$() — AND/OR then inverted.$(li)$(bold)XOR$() — on if inputs $(italic)differ$().$(li)$(bold)XNOR$() — on if inputs $(italic)match$().$(br2)$(bold)Two-Input$() variants (AND-2, NAND-2) keep things compact when you only need two lines.
pages.title: NAND · NOR · XOR
